name: – Borys Budka – Commission proposal to the Council
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the adoption by the European Atomic Energy Community of the Agreement on the interpretation and application of the Energy Charter Treaty between the European Union, the European Atomic Energy Community and their Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament approves a Council decision so the European Atomic Energy Community can sign up to an agreement on how the Energy Charter Treaty is interpreted and applied. The Energy Charter Treaty is a international agreement on cross-border energy investment. This report does not change the treaty itself. It gives Parliament's approval for the European Atomic Energy Community to adopt this interpretation agreement, alongside the European Union and its member states.

- The European Atomic Energy Community moves closer to adopting the agreement on interpreting and applying the Energy Charter Treaty.
- It affects the European Atomic Energy Community, the European Union and their member states.
- Parliament approves the proposal; the Council is asked to notify Parliament if it departs from the approved text.
